purpose: Real-backend compatibility validation; not a hardware benchmark claim

backend.network_mode: offline weights, HTTP listener bound to 127.0.0.1 only

model.tokenizer: Embedded in the pinned GGUF artifact; server-reported token counts were not retokenized

client.placement: same host as server, loopback HTTP
client.hardware_detail_limit: Sandbox denied sysctl access to CPU brand and RAM. The developer host was not isolated from other applications.

workload.prompt: List the integers from one through one hundred, separated by commas.

limits: Only this model, quantization, backend build, and non-streaming path were validated.
Small samples are unsuitable for p99 or server-capacity conclusions.
Raw request results do not record finish reasons. Direct probe explicitly confirms a length stop.
Model and tokenizer weights and backend binaries are not redistributed in this repository.
